zh.title: 水果拼盘大作战
zh.task: 找出家里至少3种当季水果，发挥想象力摆一个有趣的拼盘，拍照留念

en.title: Fruit Arrangement Art
en.task: Arrange at least 3 seasonal fruits into a creative pattern, snap a photo

zh.title: 发现日常角落
zh.task: 在家附近找一个从未注意过的角落或小路，用手机记录5个有趣的细节

en.title: Discover hidden corners
en.task: Walk to an unexplored spot near your home and capture 5 interesting details you've never noticed before with your phone

zh.title: 观察生活的隐喻
zh.task: 用手机拍下上班或上学路上最特别的一个细节，写一句20字以内的简短解读

en.title: Spot the metaphor
en.task: Photograph one unusual detail on your commute and write a one-sentence caption under 20 words

zh.title: 记录夏日落日
zh.task: 傍晚找一个视野好的地方，观察并用手机记录今天日落前后的天空颜色变化

en.title: Capture sunset
en.task: Find a spot with a good view tonight and capture the sky colors before and after sunset with your phone

zh.title: 捕捉夕阳光影
zh.task: 在日落前后30分钟内，出门找一个有光影对比的角落，用手机拍一张有故事感的照片

en.title: Chase Golden Hour
en.task: Within 30 minutes before or after sunset, go outside and capture a photo with dramatic light and shadow in a corner of your neighborhood

zh.title: 给云朵起个名
zh.task: 找一个视野好的位置，仰望天空5分钟，选一朵云，发挥想象给它起个名字

en.title: Name a Cloud
en.task: Find a spot with a good view of the sky, gaze up for 5 minutes, pick a cloud and give it a creative name

zh.title: 夏日胶囊拼贴
zh.task: 翻出家中的收据、车票或落叶，在一张纸上拼贴一张专属于今年夏天的迷你画。

en.title: Summer Capsule Collage
en.task: Gather receipts, tickets, or fallen leaves at home and glue a tiny collage that captures this summer.

zh.title: 夏日口袋册
zh.task: 用A4纸折成四页口袋册，每页记录这个夏天的一个词、一种颜色、一句气味、一笔速写。

en.title: Summer Pocket Zine
en.task: Fold an A4 paper into a 4-page pocket zine; each page captures this summer with a word, a color, a scent line, and a quick sketch.

zh.title: 夏日拼贴
zh.task: 翻出旧杂志，剪出5个代表这个夏天的词或图，拼成一页告别海报。

en.title: Summer Collage
en.task: Rummage through old magazines, cut out five words or images that capture this summer, and arrange them into a one-page farewell poster.

zh.title: 拼贴一句话
zh.task: 从旧杂志或报纸上剪下5-8个字，拼成一句你想对自己说的话，贴在你明天会看到的地方

en.title: Cut-Out Message
en.task: Cut 5–8 characters from an old magazine or newspaper, arrange them into a message for yourself, and post it where you'll see it tomorrow.

zh.title: 给夏天写封短信
zh.task: 用一张纸写一封给这个夏天的告别信（3-5句话），折成任意形状，拍照留念。

en.title: A Letter to Summer
en.task: Write a 3–5 sentence goodbye letter to this summer on a piece of paper, fold it into any shape, and snap a photo of it.

zh.title: 落叶拼图
zh.task: 捡3片形状各异的落叶，在纸上拼成你喜欢的小图案，拍照留念

en.title: Leaf Collage
en.task: Gather 3 differently shaped fallen leaves, arrange them into a small picture on paper, and snap a photo
